alignments.note: Jussive rendered by a volitive frame plus the light verb *put to shame*; the frame belongs to the verb whose mood it renders under rule 17 and the head goes on the complement under rule 44, which names `בּוֹשׁ` → *put to shame* expressly.
Second jussive; the ASV writes the volitive frame once and it stands with the first verb, so this verb keeps only its own participle-form English.
Quantifying construct noun keeps only its own word; the ASV writes no *of* for the chain.
Anarthrous substantival participle takes the supplied *they that* under rule 46, headed on the word carrying the lexeme.
The ASV renders the construct relation as a direct object, so the name keeps only its own word.

review_notes: The single volitive frame *Let them be* is placed on the first jussive rather than distributed, since only one English occurrence is written; the second verb takes the bare *turned*.
